correctness.rationale: The normalized monomial basis reduces the positive Toeplitz compression to incomplete beta integrals. Its adjacent difference is exactly an endpoint boundary term, giving a unique maximizer except for two adjacent tied modes when the threshold is integral. The logarithmic threshold is strictly increasing by covariance of a weighted mean. After y=u(1-t), gamma-ratio asymptotics yield F(x)=h*x^rho*exp(-x)/Gamma(rho); an integrable exponentially decaying bound gives all positive q trace-power Riemann sums. Trace rho*h follows exactly from the Bergman diagonal reproducing kernel. Independent checks confirm mode locations and gamma profile over rho=.75,1,2,2.5 and several u/h but do not replace the proof.
residual_risks: The real-q limit requires the indicated domination at both tails; the package supplies an exponentially integrable envelope for every q>0.
